title: MZ Check if game is fullscreen?

posts.author: myolden
posts.body:
Hey all,
Looking for a way to check if the game is currently in full screen or windowed mode (to be saved in a switch where ON is full screen and OFF is windowed). Been digging for a while, but I can't seem to find anything to do this? It seems like a pretty simple thing, though, so I might just be missing something.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
I think this script call should work:
Graphics._isFullScreen()
If the game is fullscreen, it will return true.
$gameSwitches.setValue(switchId, Graphics._isFullScreen())
